title: CI/CD Triggers
subtitle: Fire a pipeline from WorkPilot and follow the runs it started

trigger.heading: Run a pipeline
trigger.selectProviderFirst: Pick a provider before triggering a run.

empty.title: No pipeline runs yet
empty.body: Runs triggered from here — or automatically on a PR or a merge — show up in this list with the status the provider reports.
empty.noProject: Open a project to configure its CI/CD triggers.

monitor.heading: Watch after a deployment
monitor.description: After a pipeline starts from WorkPilot, the health check and the Prometheus metrics are compared with what they were before it, for a window of observation.
monitor.monitor_deploy_wait_minutes: Wait for the deployment to land (minutes)
monitor.auto_rollback: Roll back by itself on a critical verdict
monitor.autoRollbackHint: Off: the rollback is offered here. On: GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines go back to the last run that succeeded, unless the change holds a database migration.
monitor.fileHint: Metrics and thresholds: .workpilot/deploy-monitors.yaml (PromQL query, kind error_rate, latency, throughput or custom, warning and critical in percent).

watch.notConfigured: Not watched: no health check or metric is configured.
watch.migrations: Database migrations between the good version and this one: {{files}}. A rollback restores the code only; handle these migrations by hand.

rollback.started: Rollback started: the last good run is running again.
rollback.blocked_migrations: Automatic rollback blocked by a database migration.

plan.manual: This provider cannot re-run a past pipeline on its commit: start the last good one again from its page.
plan.no_previous_success: No earlier successful run to go back to.
plan.not_configured: The provider settings are incomplete for a rollback.
plan.unreachable: The provider could not be reached to plan the rollback.
plan.unsupported: Rollback is not supported for this provider.
plan.offline: Strict offline mode: no provider is called, roll back by hand.

watch.revertHint: The branch still holds the faulty commit: revert it before the next deployment.
watch.confirm: Run the last good deployment again?
